name: Bodyweight squat (draft)
targetPopulation: Adult rehabilitation patients cleared for standing weight-bearing exercise, able to squat to a clinician-approved partial range without assistive support. PLACEHOLDER - not a clinical inclusion/exclusion criterion; see docs/study-charter-skeleton.md.
contraindications: Unhealed lower-limb fracture or recent lower-limb surgery without clinician clearance
Significant balance impairment without a stable support surface available
symptomStopRules: Stop immediately on sharp knee, hip, or back pain
Stop immediately on dizziness, loss of balance, or breathlessness disproportionate to exertion
Stop and report to clinician on any new joint instability
